preconditions: Owned complete temporary project on the current native Linux filesystem; explicit test host publication/recovery authority; separate stopped writer and recovery interpreters.
steps: Observe every successful native filesystem boundary in an uninterrupted single-artifact writer, then terminate a fresh writer after each boundary without finalizers and recover solely from persisted bytes.

Retain the independently bound initial/final journal.next derivative during recovery and prove that foreign content, another cursor, unsafe links, size changes and authority-time mutation cannot be adopted.

oracle.requirement_contract: Die Referenztests MÜSSEN einen kontrollierten Prozessabbruch nach jeder dauerhaften Journal- und Dateisystemgrenze injizieren und nach Recovery jeweils exakt die Basis- oder die vollständige Zielmodellwurzel nachweisen.
oracle.scope: Exact complete basis or target bytes and independently rebuilt model root after every observed journal/staging/publication/receipt/cleanup boundary. Recoverable journals must clear the transaction gate. Pre-journal namespace cuts must retain the exact basis and all evidence while remaining blocked; they are not successful recovery. No power-loss or platform-matrix claim.

open_items: 5.v.R: extend the same native matrix to multiple changed files, receipt loss and repeated recovery interruptions. Later 20.e covers the complete transaction/customer matrix; unmeasured filesystems, real power loss and future restore clients are not approved by this local process-interruption proof.
